registry_disposition.reason: S7 qualification integration, slice S7 of the PROPOSED MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0, executed under the bounded owner run directive of 2026-10-20 (run S11 implementierung und closure S7, S13 und S8). The slice amends two canonical contract surfaces: core/contracts/qualification-fingerprint.schema.json (the required effective_instruction_digest component, the sha256:-prefixed 64-hex instruction-bundle digest form of S6) and core/contracts/materiality-decision.schema.json (the MATERIALITY_DELTA_CLASSIFICATION enum extension). Both are CONTRACT_RECORD relevance under this repository's adopted taxonomy. The runtime amends runtime/qualification/fingerprint.mjs (the closed component key set gains the digest, with fail-closed value validation) and runtime/qualification/materiality.mjs (the digest becomes a tracked component; a digest delta is MATERIAL and unroutable, and a missing or malformed digest on either side - including the case where BOTH sides lack it - is UNKNOWN and fail-closed). The coordinated data amendments are the catalog-registered fixture evals/fixtures/maws-vnext/qualification.contracts.json, the reference run spec runtime/cli/specs/reference-audit-v1.json, and the fingerprint helpers in the four affected test files. The scope boundary is explicit and is NOT claimed as implemented: the digest is a REQUIRED, TRACKED, SPEC-DECLARED fingerprint component - a qualification that was earned under a different instruction bundle can no longer be reused (the run is blocked with MATERIAL_FINGERPRINT_DRIFT or UNKNOWN_FINGERPRINT_DRIFT), and a fingerprint without the digest is rejected - but the automatic derivation of the digest from the assembled instruction bundle at runtime is NOT part of this slice and remains an OPEN obligation (the run spec still carries the digest as spec-declared data). The slice qualifies no model and no executor, grants no permission, activates no runtime and replaces no authority or approval decision. The required Registry write is COMPLETE: the run change registration registry/MAWS_QUALIFICATION_INTEGRATION_2026_10_20_001.yaml and the CONTRACT_RECORD projections registry/MAWS_QUALIFICATION_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT_2026_10_20_001.yaml were published in baum777/unitera-registry pull request 233 and merged as a4738796f2636d11a24e1b9ef9e3173247d66c95, which registry_commit_sha now records. The Atlas representation is unitera_atlas pull request 180 merged as 06fc37c3c8a9f0a2b9da2d2a3108ebb2bf5348d3. UPDATED phase: the Registry write succeeded and the Atlas representation is published. The owner-side classification is rebound from REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED to UPDATED with the registry commit sha; the recorded facts of the source change are unchanged.
